video_title: Olivia Miles Describes How It Feels To Guard Caitlin Clark

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on the difficulty of guarding Caitlin Clark
quotes.quote: We played the Fever the first time and Caitlin Clark was just killing us. She was killing us and I was like, she can't be guarded. That definitely was a welcome to the league moment where I was like, this is legit.

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on the challenge of guarding efficient players
quotes.excerpt: It's hard to guard an efficient player because they're going to make tough shots
quotes.quote: It's hard to guard an efficient player because they're going to make tough shots. Having counters as a basketball player is the best thing you can do. I see a little bit of that in Caitlin Clark and also the quickness and speed and craftiness. The blend is just crazy.

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on the playmaking abilities of Caitlin Clark and Paige Bueckers
quotes.excerpt: It is annoying to play against her, right? You got to guard her
quotes.quote: Obviously Caitlin Clark with the shooting and her playmaking ability. She's so good with her right hand attacking downhill and creating for others and obviously in transition she's deadly. It is annoying to play against her, right? You got to guard her and you got to make sure that you have bodies on her at all times and making it hard. And same for Paige Bueckers. Paige is great to her right hand and great posting up in the short corner and facilitating for her teammates as well.

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on the surgical playmaking style of Chelsea Gray
quotes.excerpt: She's a different type of player in the sense of how surgical she is
quotes.quote: She's a different type of player in the sense of how surgical she is and how the timing and her knowing where her teammates are going to be before they do. I feel like we have a lot of similarities in that way, our processing. Even though she may not be the most athletic on the floor or the quickest at her age now, no disrespect, she's still so surgical in her movements.

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on the longevity and success of Diana Taurasi
quotes.excerpt: To have the longevity that they have and to win as well is so unheard of
quotes.quote: She is multi-time champion, Olympics, World Cup. To have the longevity that they have and to win as well is so unheard of and it's so aspiring. I don't think I want to play for that long, but basketball is such a love of mine that I want to give it all I have and learn from the great. We talk about this with LeBron James as well.

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on the players she watched growing up
quotes.excerpt: Growing up I definitely watched like the Maya Moore, Sue Bird, Stewie
quotes.quote: Growing up I definitely watched like the Maya Moore, Sue Bird, Stewie. So it's weird getting to play against Stewie now. I started watching the WNBA late. I really watched the NBA and I watched Jason Williams, the Jason Kidds, Steve Nash, Stephen Curry, all those guys. Kyrie was a big influence, obviously Jersey kid.

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on the influence of Kyrie Irving and Steve Nash
quotes.excerpt: Kyrie was a big influence, obviously Jersey kid
quotes.quote: I watch the game because I love the game and I forgot to mention Kyrie. Kyrie was a big influence, obviously Jersey kid. Watching what they do, wanting to do crazy layups like that and handles and obviously Steve Nash's passing. As a student of the game, you just love to learn things and pick up different things and I feel like I have a little bit of everything in my game from people that I've watched and then kind of put your own unique turn on it.

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on developing her court vision and instincts
quotes.excerpt: I think I always had a different instinct seeing things, seeing space, reading situations, reading windows, timing
quotes.quote: I think I always had a different instinct seeing things, seeing space, reading situations, reading windows, timing. It's definitely developed over time and practice and reps and watching film has helped a lot. But I also would attribute a lot of that to soccer, like the windows and anticipation and leading people places and it definitely translates.

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on her constant desire to improve as a player
quotes.excerpt: I'm always learning and like never satisfied with what I'm doing
quotes.quote: I feel like even now I still don't feel like it's really clicked fully for me yet. I'm always learning and like never satisfied with what I'm doing. That doesn't mean I'm not grateful to be where I'm at, but I'm just hungry to learn more and to be better in every situation.

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on using data and film to improve her game
quotes.excerpt: There's so much data now and like there's like sensors in every arena
quotes.quote: Sharon and I for example watched film today on like the drives I had in the last game and just where I could have been better. There's so much data now and like there's like sensors in every arena and it tells you very specific things that you can track. I can see Stewie doesn't like this shot going right or left. Sab going right shoots a lower percentage than going left. It's little stuff like that that you can kind of pick up the tendencies easier than before.

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on handling criticism and public opinion
quotes.excerpt: You shouldn't take criticism from someone you wouldn't take advice from
quotes.quote: The thing that I've struggled with the most I think is the growing opinions and everyone like being under a microscope, but what I heard was, you shouldn't take criticism from someone you wouldn't take advice from. And that's kind of stuck with me because it's just true. You shouldn't pay attention to people that really have and hold no value over you and who are saying things that are clearly not true but obviously hurt for some reason.

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on the difficulty of ignoring public criticism
quotes.excerpt: It's so hard. Sometimes I just want to reply and I'm like Olivia, like please don't get
quotes.quote: It's so hard. Sometimes I just want to reply and I'm like Olivia, like please don't get because it's not worth it. They have nothing to lose, like we have everything to lose on our end and like it's so hard to sit there and be like this is not true or like you don't have any idea what you're talking about.

quotes.speaker: Olivia Miles
quotes.summary_phrase: Olivia Miles on focusing on basketball over external narratives
quotes.excerpt: Maybe we focus a little more on basketball and less on like the external stuff
quotes.quote: Some of the topics get kind of dicey and that's maybe what I would change is like maybe we focus a little more on basketball and less on like the external stuff. But even so, like having people talk and pay attention is what we asked for, right? We can't ask for all the good and have no bad as well. There's a balance there and there's meaning in those conversations as well. It's all growing our game one way or another.
